svg.title: ruPro workspace · learning across runs
svg.desc: Claude proposes a retry rule, Codex tests it, and the owner approves lesson M17. Catalog recalls M17 on a new read timeout. A simulated Catalog replay compares six passing cases without memory to eight with the lesson. Billing then checks a timed out payment against its receipt and records the owner’s decision. GitHub Copilot checks replay evidence in this simulated team. An architecture decision record preserves the reason for the rule. A later replay reveals a missed deadline and the owner approves a successor. Isometric swarm routing, a vector projection and a spiral replay chart illustrate the learning cycle. The final three scenes show cross-project monitoring, a browser preview and department capacity planning.

g.text: Claude finds a GET that worked on retry.
Codex tests the rule. Copilot checks the evidence.
Copilot checked the trace and all three tests.
Lesson M17 saved with its test evidence.
M17 matches the Catalog read timeout.
Check the approved rule before applying one retry.
Two more cases pass in the simulated replay.
Carry failed cases into the next learning cycle.
This payment was a POST. Skip the retry.
Copilot matched the receipt to the run.
Repeating a charge can bill twice.
Reads: retry once after a timeout.
The caller had already stopped waiting.
Retry a timed out GET once.
✓ Owner approved A2. M17 now cites it.
Billing needs an owner to check the receipt.
Open Billing to confirm the customer was charged once.
The first request returned no order details.
One retry brought the order back on screen.
Copilot checks the visible result against the trace.
Who has the most work left?
Operations has 2 of the 3 open requests.
Engineering has one request left. Customer has none.
